source: Owner's Mac checkout of agp-Cockpit on main 38cdb618, Cockpit v0.3.0 (build release-0.3.0) in mission mode with ChatGPT, Kit 1.1.1 in the workspace .venv; transfer order generated by Claude with Kit 1.1.1 from PyPI and pushed to origin

order.rehearsal: Before the live run the same order ran in a disposable clone with a bare origin: PASS, and the same three untracked files afterwards

cockpit_run.dispatched: exactly once (Cockpit step 2100, 1 remote turn, 1 step)
cockpit_run.approval: decision scope 'Push, PR und Merge' with the note limiting it to this one remote-next; the scope 'Push und PR, ohne Merge' permits only transfer push-current and transfer pr-create, so it could not authorize remote-next
cockpit_run.before_the_run: ChatGPT assumed the transfer branch did not exist (the Cockpit facts show no origin branches) and twice asked for push-current/pr-create; one rejection; no remote effect ran before the approved remote-next

kit_report.anchor_check: anchor_basis order_commit_parent, anchor_expected c4fc3b8b... equals expected_current_head
kit_report.apply: write_text_file docs/validation/evidence/file_transfer_live/probe-20261019.txt written: true, sha256 matches the payload

after_the_run.checkout: transfer/file-transfer-live-20261019 @ 6fbdf1a6, local HEAD equal to the origin branch; the Cockpit showed 'Arbeit auf transfer/file-transfer-live-20261019 offen' with 3 changes
after_the_run.cleanup: Owner ran Download/agp_file_transfer_live_cleanup_20261019.py (local, not committed): identity, branch, exact untracked set, published reports and the sha256 checked, the three files moved to Download/file-transfer-live-20261019/, switched to main; DONE on main 38cdb618, worktree clean

findings_recorded.KIT-GF-074: transfer order-create writes only write_text_file actions; command orders could not be generated
findings_recorded.KIT-GF-075: transfer remote-next publishes only its own reports and leaves the order's products untracked on the transfer branch
findings_recorded.KIT-GF-076: found by the Kit's regression fixture for 074/075, not in this workspace: .gitkeep carriers in the transfer inbox block remote-next of a fresh workspace

cockpit_findings_open: The human decision offers only 'Push und PR, ohne Merge' or the whole remote effect; a FILE_TRANSFER can only be approved with the broad scope and the restriction to one command is prose in the note
The facts the Cockpit sends to the remote LLM do not list origin branches, so it took an existing transfer branch for missing
